title: Penguin Solutions to Showcase Full-Stack AI Factory Platform Innovations at SC26
summary: Technology demonstrations, customer deployments, and technical presentations highlight advances in AI infrastructure and memory technologies designed to accelerate deployment, optimize performance, and improve token economics Penguin Solutions , Inc. (Nasdaq: PENG ), the AI Factory Platform Company, today announced its participation at SC26, the international conference for high-performance computing (HPC), networking, storage, and analysis, taking place November 15-20, 2026, in Chicago. At booth #1723, Penguin Solutions will demonstrate innovations across its Full-Stack AI Factory Platform, including infrastructure software, accelerated compute systems, advanced memory technologies, and operational services. The company will also share insights from customer deployments and participate in technical presentations addressing emerging challenges in AI. What: Penguin Solutions at SC26, booth #1723 When: Sunday, November 15 - Friday, November 20, 2026 Where: McCormick Place,
body_markdown:
Penguin Solutions is the AI Factory Platform Company. We design, build, and manage next-generation data centers for enterprises, sovereign AI initiatives, and neocloud providers.


With deep design expertise at the intersection of data center AI infrastructure and memory solutions, our Full-Stack AI Factory Platform combines differentiated infrastructure software, advanced memory, compute systems, end-to-end services, and industry-leading partner technologies to help customers accelerate deployment, optimize token economics, and maximize the return on their AI investments.
